name: LFW
description: Face verification dataset with about 13k images and 6000 pairs, using a 10-fold protocol. Subject to UMass research terms; this metadata record does not vendor data.
citation: Huang, G. B., Ramesh, M., Berg, T., & Learned-Miller, E. (2007). Labeled Faces in the Wild (LFW): A Database for Studying Face Recognition in Unconstrained Environments.
